runtime_reference.meaning: Attributes7 include runtime visibility. Without runtime access, variables are not visible to GetVariable after ExitBootServices. Enhanced-authenticated payloads can include metadata and cannot be decoded as plain setup bytes.

capture_implication.result: The original PBS persistence code supports the existing Windows read attempt as a specific runtime-variable target. Current existence/attributes and Windows acceptance remain unmeasured.

scan_scope.limits: Exact name/GUID and selected instruction searches are triage, not whole-firmware reachability or absence proofs. PEI copies are duplicates by hash. Main PD-policy consumer not recovered.
